title: ChatHealthy Facility Taxonomy Bucket
description: A hand-curated membership set of NUCC taxonomy codes for one facility-filter macro-bucket (e.g. Psychiatric). A taxonomy is in the bucket iff its code appears in codes[]; editing codes[] retunes the bucket with no code change.

$schema.description: URL of the schema this document declares itself against.

_note.description: Human curation note. Not consumed at runtime.

bucket.description: The facility-filter macro-bucket this set defines.

codes.description: NUCC taxonomy codes that belong to the bucket.
